name: Architecture · cloud landing zone (nav rail)
purpose: A traditional landing-zone map: an organization boundary, governance accounts (management, security and logging, network hub), and production and non-production workload accounts with a VPC, public and private subnets and the managed services that compose them.

source_advisory_slots.note: 3 accounts, 2-4 service logo slots each, service name 22 chars
production and non-production, each a network with public, private app and private data subnets
a logo slot or icon node per service; AWS names in this sample; swap services and logos per provider
